CREATE TABLE "public"."events" (
  "capacity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "city" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "creator_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (uuidv7()) NOT NULL,
  "location" text NOT NULL,
  "min_age" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "sold_tickets" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "starts_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "state" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'draft' NOT NULL,
  "ticket_price_cents" int4 NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "event_capacity_positive_2e07dccc" CHECK (capacity > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "event_city_not_blank_dd00f551" CHECK (length(btrim(city)) > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "event_location_not_blank_6da3d33f" CHECK (length(btrim(location)) > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "event_min_age_non_negative_f7a38054" CHECK (min_age >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT "event_sold_tickets_non_negative_ccdc5d6f" CHECK (sold_tickets >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT "event_sold_tickets_within_capacity_2a5d55d1" CHECK (sold_tickets <= capacity),
  CONSTRAINT "event_ticket_price_non_negative_ced1f005" CHECK (ticket_price_cents >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT "event_title_not_blank_e4be2e72" CHECK (length(btrim(title)) > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "events_state_check_eed704be" CHECK ("state" IN ('AC', 'AL', 'AP', 'AM', 'BA', 'CE', 'DF', 'ES', 'GO', 'MA', 'MT', 'MS', 'MG', 'PA', 'PB', 'PR', 'PE', 'PI', 'RJ', 'RN', 'RS', 'RO', 'RR', 'SC', 'SP', 'SE', 'TO')),
  CONSTRAINT "events_status_check_2a618994" CHECK ("status" IN ('draft', 'published', 'finished', 'canceled'))
)
